findings.evidence: Diff: `theorem of_mul_of (g h : G) : (of g ...) * of h = (α g h : k) • of (g * h)` has no attribute; `MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single` in Mathlib is @[simp].
findings.fix: Add @[simp] to of_mul_of (and consider @[grind] on of_mul_of/of_one). It cannot loop: the RHS `α g h • of (g*h)` contains no `of _ * of _` product.
findings.issue: of_mul_of is the defining computation rule `of g * of h = α g h • of (g*h)`, the primary normal-form lemma of the algebra, but it is not annotated @[simp] (while the neighboring of_one is). Its Mathlib analog MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single carries @[simp].

findings.evidence: Line 60 `@[expose] public section`; `grep -rl '@[expose] public section' TauCeti/` = 15 vs 924 files with `public section`. Complete API test of the rubric is met, so bodies need not be exposed.
findings.fix: Drop `@[expose]` (use plain `public section`); if any single downstream consumer genuinely must unfold one def, add @[expose] to that def alone rather than the whole section.
findings.issue: `@[expose] public section` exposes the bodies of every definition (twistedTranslation, twistedGroupAlgebra, of, basis, lift, the equivs), but the file supplies the full characteristic API (of_mul_of, of_one, basis_apply, lift_of, algHom_ext, twistedTranslation_single, finrank_eq_natCard), so no consumer needs to unfold or compute a body. Only 15 of 924 `public section` files use @[expose].

summary: The characteristic API is essentially complete and extensionality (algHom_ext, basis) is in place, but the central multiplication-table lemma of_mul_of lacks @[simp], and the whole file exposes all bodies via @[expose] despite that complete API.
